description: This file defines a struct 'CachedMessage' which represents a serialized message in a streaming cache, along with extension methods for comparison operations based on sequence number and stream ID.

classes.name: CachedMessage
classes.description: A tightly packed structure containing stream message metadata such as stream ID, sequence number, event index, enqueue and dequeue times, and segment data.

classes.name: CachedMessageExtensions
classes.description: Provides extension methods for comparing CachedMessage instances with sequence tokens and stream IDs.

methods.name: Compare
methods.description: Compares the cached message with a sequence token based on sequence number and event index.

methods.name: CompareStreamId
methods.description: Checks if the cached message's stream ID matches the provided stream ID.
